name: Walk across uneven ground
short_description: Walk 100 metres across ordinary uneven ground while choosing stable steps.
self_assessment: I can walk 100 metres across uneven ground without help or a fall.
description: Walk 100 metres across ordinary uneven ground while choosing stable steps. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
